_comment: EDIT THIS FILE to change studio info, photos and copy. It is committed to git and bundled into every deploy, so changes persist on any host (including Vercel) with NO cloud storage, database, or token. To change a photo: replace the file in /public/images and/or point the 'image' path here to a new file you added there. After editing, commit and redeploy.
